"requires_payment_method" – a card is needed, either because none was given or because the last one was declined.
"requires_confirmation" – a card has been given; call to pay.

member.name: T:Strajp.PaymentIntentService
member.summary: Creates and confirms payments.
member.remarks:
Test cards:
12341,000 SEK. Works.
99991,000,000 SEK. Works.
00000 SEK. Declined with "insufficient_funds".
1111Reported lost. Declined with "lost_card".
2222Expired. Fails with code "expired_card".
333310,000 SEK, max 500 SEK per purchase. Declined with "card_velocity_exceeded" above the limit.
4444Always fails with code "processing_error".
55551,000 SEK. Every other attempt fails with code "processing_error", starting with the first.
All other card numbers fail in with code "incorrect_number". Balances decrease when a payment succeeds and are reset when the program restarts.
